definitions.CN: water O within 0.35 nm of carbonyl O. Site counts may share a water.
definitions.HB: Water-donor D–H···carbonyl O, D···A <=0.35 nm, D–H···A >=150°. Triplets per carbonyl.
definitions.SD: Descriptive sample SD across three independently initialized run means; not a confidence interval.
definitions.W1: Maximum pairwise Wasserstein-1 distance among empirical replica distributions, reported in each observable’s native unit; descriptive, without an independent-frame p-value.
definitions.blocks: Four time blocks in order; arrays ordered by increasing numeric replica seed.
definitions.contrast: Mean(Me/OH) - mean(H/H). Replica means weighted equally, and whole-cap change is joint. No pairing across chemistries.
definitions.core_rg: Mass-weighted common repeat heavy atoms C15N3O3, with both models excluding H and Me/OH model also excluding cap methyl C and terminal O.
definitions.ess: Per-run finite-lag, positive/monotone-pair autocorrelation estimate. tau_int=0.5*g*dt. Short records can understate slow modes.
definitions.rhat: Rank-normalized split R-hat and folded rank-normalized split R-hat, upper value. Exploratory diagnostic for MD replicas.

longitudinal_hh.scope: Initial and final new windows and archived pilot are separately summarized. Velocities were resampled before the new production.
